description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在探討組織中有關「人的行為」、以及「行為背後的原因」。課程內容包括三大部份： 個體行為、群體行為、及組織系統特性。 瞭解組織中各種行為及背後原因，將甚有助於管理者做好管理工作。
description.describe_eh: This course aims at human behaviors and , especially, reasons behind various behaviors in organizations. The contents of this course includes three parts ： individual behavior, group behavior, and organization system. To understand human behaviors and their reasons will give much help to managers for making organizations effective.

targets.describe_ch: 能了解組織行為之意義與內涵, 並能瞭解組織中有關個人行為、群體行為、組織系統特性等方面之重要知識、理論、原則、與實務。
targets.describe_en: To understand the meaning and contents of Organizational Behavior (OB) and the knowledge, theories, principles and practice related to individual behavior, group behavior and organization system in an organization.

targets.describe_ch: 能了解溝通的原理,技巧及重要性, 並能運用組織行為之相關知識及本身人際能力，用溝通來促進組織中之合作、協調、領導與工作表現。
targets.describe_en: To realize the principles, skills and importance of communication and be able to utilize the relevant knowledge and social skills to improve cooperation, coordination, leadership, and job performance through communication in an organization.

targets.describe_ch: 能運用組織行為之基本知識來思考如何從事有效之管理並解決問題。

3.課堂參與：10% 分組討論、課程問答

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. Leave Policy: 
Except for bereavement leave, all absences will result in point deductions: 3% for unexcused absences, 2% for personal leave, and 1% for sick leave or official leave. Retroactively requesting personal leave (except for sick leave) will incur an additional 1% deduction.
If the total number of absences (of any type) exceeds half of the roll call sessions, the attendance score (15%) will be zero.
Sick leave must be supported by a medical receipt with a valid date.
If you arrive late and miss roll call, you must follow the procedure to request leave for that session (or any prior sessions) accordingly.
2. Midterm & Final Exams:
Personal leave is not allowed for midterm and final exams.
Students who are unable to attend these exams will receive a zero unless they provide a doctor's note for sick leave. No make-up exams will be given.
3. Individual Reports (Learning Sheets or Written Reports):
Except for handwritten assignments completed in class, written reports should be no more than three pages, using size 12 font, 1.5-line spacing, and a standard layout.

1. 請假規則 : 除喪假外,所有的缺曠課都會扣分，曠課3%，事假2%，病假/公假 1%，除病假外事後補請均多扣1％。累計所有假別次數超過點名次數1/2不到者，出席成績(15%)為 0 分。病假一律以有日期的醫療收據為準，因遲到而來不及點名者，請依規定補請當節(及之前)之請假，
2. 期中期末考不允許事假缺席，除病假(具醫師開立證明)外，無法參與期中或期末考者一律零分計算不予補考。
3. 個人報告(學習單或書面報告)，除課堂中手寫外，以3頁以內為限，12級字，1.5倍行高，標準版面。
